title: Successful is the one who embraces Islam, is provided with mere subsistence, and Allah makes him content with what He has given him
hadeeth: ‘Abdullah ibn ‘Amr ibn al-‘Ās (may Allah be pleased with him and his father) reported that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said: "Successful is the one who embraces Islam, is provided with mere subsistence, and Allah makes him content with what He has given him."
explanation: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) clarified that one who submits to his Lord and is, thus, guided and led to Islam, and is provided with just enough lawful sustenance to meet his needs, without excess or deficiency, and Allah makes him content and satisfied with what He has granted him has truly succeeded and achieved victory.
hints: A person's happiness lies in the perfection of his religion, the sufficiency of his livelihood, and his contentment with what Allah has given him.
Encouraging contentment with what you have been given of this world, along with Islam and the Sunnah.
hadeeth_intro: ‘Abdullah ibn ‘Amr ibn al-‘Ās (may Allah be pleased with him and his father) reported that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said:
hadeeth_ar: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ رضي الله عنهما أنَّ رَسولَ اللَّهِ صلَّى اللَّهُ عليْه وسلَّمَ، قال: «قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن أَسْلَمَ، وَرُزِقَ كَفَافًا، وَقَنَّعَهُ اللَّهُ بما آتَاهُ».
hadeeth_intro_ar: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ رضي الله عنهما أنَّ رَسولَ اللَّهِ صلَّى اللَّهُ عليْه وسلَّمَ، قال:
explanation_ar: بيّن النبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قد فاز وظفر مَن انقاد إلى ربه فَهُدِي ووفق للإسلام، ورزق من الحلال قدْر حاجته من غير زيادة ولا نقص، وجعله الله قانعًا راضيًا بما أعطاه.
hints_ar: سعادة المرء في كمال دينه وكفاف عيشه وقناعته بما آتاه الله.
الترغيب في القناعة بما أوتيت من الدنيا مع الإسلام والسنة.
